scenes.text: Did you know there is a secret, invisible highway hidden deep inside the world's oceans where a single human whisper could theoretically travel thousands of miles without ever fading away?
This is the mysterious SOFAR channel, a bizarre underwater depth where cold temperatures and crushing pressure create a perfect acoustic trap that keeps sound waves bouncing forever.
Blue whales regularly use this massive watery corridor to sing to their mates across entire continents, while scientists can hear underwater volcanic explosions from thousands of miles away.
Cold War spies even used this hidden layer to locate crashed missiles, so tell me in the comments if you would dare to dive down there, and follow for more.
